decision.explanation: Both Elizabeth Goldsborough and William Ivan Gurney are presented as spouses of Anne Marie Deutsch in separate documents. D1S4 explicitly states that Anne Marie Deutsch and Elizabeth Goldsborough entered into a private marriage ceremony in 1675. D2S3 describes Anne Marie Deutsch and William Ivan Gurney as having forged a lasting marriage. These are distinct historical contexts (17th century vs. 20th century) and referents, so both are valid under the given instruction to preserve separately valid referents and complementary answers.
